blocks.text: Beauty Salon Interior Design, 63 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design project for a 63 m² beauty salon, creating a stylish, functional and comfortable commercial space for both clients and beauty professionals.

The layout was carefully planned to accommodate different working areas, including spaces for hairdressers, manicure and brow specialists, a cosmetologist’s room, reception and staff area. Functional zoning helps organize daily workflows efficiently while maintaining a cohesive and welcoming interior.

The project combines contemporary aesthetics with practical solutions for a professional beauty environment. Particular attention was given to ergonomics, lighting, storage and the organization of individual workstations. The design project also includes the necessary technical documentation for its implementation.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides interior design for beauty salons, hair salons, beauty studios and other commercial spaces in Bratislava and Vienna. Our services can include interior design, custom furniture, detailed technical documentation and comprehensive turnkey renovation — from the initial concept to the finished interior.
